tei:div.tei:p: /rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi shin tu gsang ba'i rnam thar nyams len bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// /bde chen sgyu ma'i gar gyi rnam rol srid zhi'i dpal// sku gsum bdun ldan dang po'i mgon po dri med chos sku nyid// mi 'gyur bde ba chen po zhes bya dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// zla bral bla mar snang ba'i zhabs pad gtsug gis 'dud// rdo rje 'chang dbang khyod nyid ji ltar mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul ni// sa gsum 'jig rten kun gyis dpag par dka' ba las// bcos min snying dad kho nas rab tu bstod bgyis nas// gsung don dri med bka' yis stsal du gsol// de lta bas na bdag nyid chen po nyid kyi/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas pa las/ bdag cag gi snang ngor ji ltar mdzad pa'i rnam thar gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba mdzad nas gnang ba las/ da dung yang de nyid kyi 'phros las/ rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi bkas byin rlabs ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang*/ lhag pa'i lha rnams kyis mtshan ma rtags ci lta bu byung ba dang*/ bka'i srung ma khyad par can rnams kyis phrin las rnam bzhi ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul lugs rnams dang*/ khyad par du rje nyid kyi dgongs pa'i mthil phyin pa'i gnas lugs thugs nyams su bzhes tshul rnams/ zin bris zhib rgyas shig gsang ba'i rnam thar 'di la mu mthud nas bri rgyu gcig bka' drin du mas bskyang bar zhu lags/ snang mdzad chen po thub chen po// chos sku chen po lhun grub che// bde ba chen po sprul sku che// mdzad pa chen po don chen stsol//

shin tu gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi zhu ba skul tshig nyi ma'i 'od zer bla ma gsod nams rgya mtsho bas zhus pa'o // ༈ //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ chos sku spros dang bral ba nam mkha'i dbyings// longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen ngo bo nyid// sprul sku shākya thub pas 'gro don mdzad// 'jig rten gsum mgon bla ma'i zhabs pad mchod// ces bstod nas de yang rgya chen bsod nams kyi dpal gyi phan pa dang bde ba'i rtsa lag tu gyur cing*/ sems can thams cad dang kun gyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi chen por gyur pa/ bla na ma mchis zhing gong na med pa/ rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i ring lugs de dag skyong ba rnams kyis cod pan du dbang bskur ba thob pa/ spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa'i rgyal tshab/ mtshan don gong du brjod pa don gyi slad du/ bla ma chen po bsod nams rgya mtsho bas/ bdag nyid la skyes thob dang sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan med kyang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal tshab/ 'bri gung chos kyi rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i chos kyi seng ge'i khri la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rigs bsdus/ sku gsum mngon gyur gyi sangs rgyas/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab/ mnyam med rin chen chos kyi rgyal pos gtso mdzad/ kha che'i dge slong shākya shrī'i ring lugs skyong ba/ chos lung tshogs pa'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur ba thob pas/ de nyid kyi grangs kyi rim pa rnam par gzhag pa'i re ba dang*/ rang re 'bri gung pa'i chos mdzod dar ba dang*/ gdul byar gyur pa rnams dad pa'i spu long rgyas par dmigs te/ slad rol du gsang ba'i rnam thar dgos ces bskul bas/ kun rdzob spangs te nges pa don gyi shar tshul cung zad yi ge'i ris su bkod de/ 'dan lung pa'i sa phyogs su bskur zhes tha snyad bzhag pa de'o// slar yang de'i nyer 'phros gong ma rnams kyi bka'i byin rlabs ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang*/

lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi rtags dang mtshan ma ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang*/ bka'i srung ma khyad par can rnams kyis phrin las rnam bzhi ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul lugs rnams dang*/ khyad par nyid kyi dgongs pa'i mthil phyin pa'i gnas lugs thugs nyams su bzhes tshul rnams gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba bshad du gsol zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ lan du med pa spangs te 'di skad brjod do// rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi bkas byin rlabs ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la/ rje nyid kyis zab chos gser khang sgo bcad ma nas/ mi rabs bcu gsum pa la gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong bar 'ong*/ shing 'di s+t+wa yu ste'u yu ba nyan pa'i tshad du 'ong gsungs pa'i lo grangs shing tshad dus tshod mnyam pas na/ rje nyid kyis bdag byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su bzung ngo snyam mo// gzhan yang slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lung zin/ mon gter ston pad+ma gling pas gsungs te/ gu ru'i lung bstan las/ 'bri gung spyan snga 'di u rgyan gyis gsung gi sprul pa yin zhes pa dang*/ ma 'ongs lung bstan du tshigs su bcad de/ zhang tshan 'khrugs pas dbus gtsang sil bur gtong : mi mthun sde la gnod pa sna tshogs 'byung : snang mdzad mi g.yo rab tu brtan par gnas: de ni 'bri gung spyan snga bcu gsum pa: zhes gsungs snang bas/ mnyam med u rgyan gyi bkas byin gyis brlabs shing gnang ba sbyin pa'o// gnyis pa ltar na lhag pa'i lha'i rtags mtshan mthong ba la/ dpal mnyam med u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi drag po'i gnas ti sgro brag dkar mkha' 'gro 'du ba/ sde lnga'i tshogs khang chen mor bdag rnams kyis/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i tshe sgrub nyams su blangs pas/ zhag bdun phrag gcig gi nyin/ nyams snang lta bu la/ gu ru rin po che sku mngon du mjal te/ phreng ba'i tshad gcig ston pa dang*/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i rtags rnams byung ngo*// gsum pa bka'i srung ma rnams kyis phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i tshul/

zhi ba'i las sgrub pa/ byang du me nyag ring mo'i grwa pa rnams bshar dus/ ja'i slong mo la phyin par 'dod kyang*/ nad sna tshogs yod ces pa'i sgras skrag par gyur pa las/ nang par tho rangs kyi dus su/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma chibs zhon khams mo'i chas su bstan te/ 'di skad gsungs so// dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba// zhes grags nas byung bas/ nad sna rnams kyi gnod pa las grol bar byas so// dbang gi las sgrub pa la/ bdag rnams mgon khang rnying mar gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal rtsa gsum dril sgrub nyams su blangs pas/ zhag bdun phrag gnyis pa la/ mi dmar po ral pa kham ser gyen du brdzes pa zhig gis/ lcags kyu gcig zhags pa gcig phreng ba brgya yod pa gcig byin byung bas/ tha snyad du bzung ba'o// rgyas pa'i las sgrub pa la/ gong du bkod pa ltar thog kha gser khang nang mar/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa gtso 'khor ser po mngon sum du mjal te/ rgyas pa'i las grub pa'i rtags te/ stag lung chos rje ngag dbang grags pas kyang rtags mtshan 'di byung bas/ rnam thar du rgyas par ngos bzung 'dug pas gtan tshigs su byas so// drag po'i phrin las grub tshul ni/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma yum mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i tshul du sprul nas/ 'bri gdan sde 'khrugs chen po byung dus bdag rnams ji ltar 'gyur zhes zhus pas/ sems sna ma mang dang mi skyon no// zhes gsung gi snang ba sbyin pa dang*/ bye brag tu shin tu dka' ba'i gnas skabs su/ mtshe'u kha'i gzims chung 'phyong rtse nang mar/ nangs par tho rangs kyi skabs su/ bstan srung a phyi chos kyi sgron ma de nyid/ chibs pa chu rta sngo nag la bcibs te/ rgyan thams cad kyis rab tu spras/ rngam stabs dang*/ bya rgod po'i slog pa gsol nas chibs rab tu bskyod de mngon sum du mjal zhing dgra phyogs su 'byon pa mthong bas/ mi mthun pa thams cad tshar bcad de/

rang re'i bstan pa zla ba gza' las rgyal ba bzhin du byas so// da ni nyams su len lugs dgos zhes pa la/ myong ba'i bye brag rnam thar gong du rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis su byas te bkod pa ltar dang*/ da lta thun bar thams cad du gnas lugs la bzhag nas/ yul snang dang sre ba ste/ sgom pa'i blo dang bral kyang*/ shor thob kyi snyems med tsam du snang ngo*// mtshan bcas kyi rim pa snga thun dang po'i dus su/ rdo rje'i glus bskul nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i ngang nas/ he ru ka sngon po lhan skyes su sgom pa'i rim pa gnyis dang bzlas pa/ bar du rgya gar dzo ki'i bsrung bzlog dang tshe sgrub/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i bsrung bzlog dang rdzas sngags/ sgom chen klu mes kyi tshe sgrub/ yang tshe sgrub ras chung lugs/ rlung dgang ba/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo/ mgon dkar/ rga lo dang rtswa mi lugs kyi tshe sgrub/ gu ru mtsho skyes lugs kyi sgrub thabs chen mo/ gcod la thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor las/ snga thun dang po sde mgon gyi mngon dkyil sgrub thabs/ 'khor lo gcig ma/ mos gus srog 'khor gyi las tshogs/ thugs rje chen po yid bzhin 'khor lo/ gtum po sum rtsegs/ gsang bdag 'gro bzang snying po dang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs rnams byed/ langs nas phyag mchod bsdus pa/ tsha thog tu rje gsum ldan ma/ rjes dran rnams 'chag med/ gung tshigs la rjes dran gro gtor/ gcod kyi gung thun/ dgong mo'i skabs su gcod thun/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyun gtor cha bcu/ bskang gtor sogs phrin las tshang ma/ de'i rjes su gshin rje'i bsrung bzlog sher snying*/ seng gdong sogs bzlog pa/ mtshan brjod sogs mdo phran phal gzungs rnams grub rjes/ phyag mchod/ srod la gcod kyi thun tha ma/ ye shes mgon po 'khor lo lnga ma'i dmar khrid/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i bar dang*/

nyal dmigs rnams te/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi dge sbyor ro// zla ba byung ngo cog gi bco lnga la/ brgya phyag 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa las byung ba'i theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong*/ sems bskyed len pa sngags sdom la rigs lnga sdom bzung dang*/ de'i nyin sman lha mdo chog 'jam sdud smon gsum bzlas/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu la 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis ma/ mar ngo la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma/ nyer dgu la dgu gtor gsol 'debs rin chen sgrol ma tshang ma rnams so// shin tu ches gsang ba'i rnam thar te/ rab tu sba bar bya'o// da lta nyams su len pa 'chag med rnams dri ba gron spangs te/ snying nas rnam thar kha skong dang*/ mnyes byed du bkod pa'o// dge 'dis bdag gzhan sems can gyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa rnams// bdag la sogs pa dge don du// phyin ci ma log bsngo bar bgyi// legs byas yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel gyur cig// rgyal ba kun dga'i mtshan can gyi shin tu gsang ba'i rnam thar nyams len bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes ba rdzogs so//
